name: Optimize e-commerce product listings for search engines
description: Users asked to create or modify product listings for online marketplaces, primarily focusing on SEO-optimized titles, product descriptions, and tags for platforms like Amazon and Etsy. Many requests specifically involved bulk-editing large lists of product titles to meet character count constraints and keyword exclusion rules, while others focused on crafting detailed, persuasive copy for individual items.
